name: Todd Kuhns
headline: VP of Services
about:
I am a Services and Customer Experience leader with more than 22 years of experience building and scaling global post-sales organizations that drive measurable customer outcomes, retention, and revenue growth in SaaS and enterprise technology environments.

My leadership focus centers on transforming reactive support and delivery teams into proactive Customer Experience organizations aligned to the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and adoption through renewal, expansion, and advocacy. I partner closely with executive leadership teams to ensure customer strategy directly supports company growth objectives.

Currently serving as Vice President of Professional Services at Acumatica, I lead a global organization of 75+ professionals responsible for implementation, consulting, and customer engagement. By aligning operational execution with customer value realization, my teams have achieved:

• 97% customer satisfaction (CSAT)
• Consistent revenue target overachievement
• Time-to-value reduction
• Scalable service offerings supporting adoption and expansion
• Stronger executive visibility into customer outcomes and performance

Throughout my career, I have worked at the intersection of Services, Customer Success, Product, Sales, and Support — translating customer insight into product direction, improving retention, and enabling sustainable growth.

I am particularly passionate about:
• Building high-performing global teams
• Developing data-driven customer lifecycle strategies
• Creating customer-first cultures grounded in accountability and outcomes
• Turning customer insight into strategic advantage
• Ultimately leading to improved Net Revenue Retention and reduced customer churn

Gold Globee Award Winner — Executive of the Year (Customer Services & Success)
… more

experiences.description:
Leader responsible for global Services organization supporting SaaS ERP customers worldwide. Partner closely with Executive and Leadership members to align customer lifecycle execution with corporate growth strategy while evolving services toward a proactive customer experience model.

Key Contributions & Impact
•	Lead international organization of 75+ professionals across implementation, consulting,  development, and customer engagement functions.
•	Achieved 97% customer satisfaction (CSAT) while consistently exceeding services revenue targets.
•	Realigned organizational structure to support scalable global growth and lifecycle ownership.
•	Designed and launched numerous new service offerings focused on adoption, value realization, and customer outcomes.
•	Act as executive escalation leader, formalizing collaboration between customers, Product Management, and Engineering.
•	Provide executive reporting and performance insights tied to customer outcomes and organizational KPIs.

Promoted to accelerate development of a global services and customer engagement organization and serve on leadership team.

•	Scaled global team to 45+ consultants, developers, analysts, and QA professionals.
•	Built implementation methodology reducing time-to-value from 9 months to 90 days.
•	Developed Services offering reducing customer entry cost from $60K to $12K, improving adoption and expansion readiness.
•	Exceeded services revenue goals every year while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
•	Partnered with Sales and Product leadership to align delivery outcomes with growth objectives.

Selected by executive leadership to transform underperforming global support organization.
•	Increased CSAT from 70% to 95% within 18 months.
•	Established U.S.-based support center and implemented KPI-driven operational model.
•	Introduced structured escalation processes linking Support, Product, and Engineering.
•	Designed and launched paid support program improving cost recovery and scalability.
•	Built foundation for future Customer Success and Services organization.
•	Manage International Support and Services team members
•	Develop and roll out new paid support programs for Partners, ISVs, and OEMs.
•	Exceed Revenue goals

As a product professional, I've had the opportunity to develop and implement successful strategies that drive product adoption and customer satisfaction. Some of my key accomplishments include:

• Spearheaded product rollouts, crafting compelling product positioning documents to showcase the value proposition and drive market interest
• Collaborated with development teams to review functional design documents, ensuring seamless project execution and adherence to project development plans and schedules
• Identified and managed beta customers, successfully navigating the beta and managed availability release processes to drive product refinement and market readiness
• Established and managed the Company's product release cycle, including product updates via website, product documentation, release notes, announcements, and product launch plan activities
• Contributed to the development of knowledge bases, community forums, newsletters, wikis, and blogs to drive customer engagement and product awareness
• Delivered webinars for prospects, end-users, and partners to increase awareness of product functions and features, driving interest and adoption
• Provided product education and presented at company events and conferences, showcasing product expertise and driving business growth
• Developed comprehensive product training materials to ensure seamless customer onboarding and product adoption

experiences.description:
PRACTICE MANAGER	MAR. 2011 – APR. 2013
A member of the Executive Team, reporting directly to the Owner.  I was responsible for ERP Business Solutions Business Unit.  Managing a full team of Marketing, Sales, Consulting and Development team members.  Greatest achievement was transitioning company into the black within 12 months after being the in the red for multiple years prior. 

ERP CONSULTANT	OCT. 2003 – MAR. 2011
Responsible for full customer experience starting with Sales Solution Architect, Project Manager, Business Consultant, and Developer.  Averaging a 95% billing rate and go to person for customer escalation situations.

As a seasoned leader, I've consistently demonstrated my ability to drive customer-centric innovation, deliver exceptional experiences, and drive business growth.
• Redesigned organizational structure to unlock consultant potential and drive customer-centric outcomes
• Achieved exceptional customer satisfaction metrics, including a 94% billing rate
• Developed and implemented industry-leading solutions, including Best Fixed Assets, to drive business growth and efficiency
• Spearheaded database migrations to Solomon, ensuring seamless customer transitions and reduced churn
• Led multiple high-profile projects, delivering exceptional customer experiences through new installations and conversions
• Designed and implemented intuitive Crystal Reports 6 and 8.x, empowering customers with data-driven insights and transparency

As a seasoned IT leader, I've had the privilege of driving strategic initiatives that have transformed the technology and operations landscape of two 250 million-dollar company. Some of my key accomplishments include:
• Collaborated with upper-level management to develop a technical strategy, aligning IT initiatives with business objectives
• Seamlessly integrating two massive companies' systems and processes, ensuring a smooth transition for customers and employees alike
• Successfully relocating the company's headquarters to a new location, minimizing disruption and ensuring business continuity
• Spearheaded the ERP vendor selection process, identifying the best solution for our business needs and driving digital transformation
• Managed capital expenditures, including the redesign of PCs and phone systems, to enhance employee productivity and customer experience
• Led the conversion of multiple accounting database systems to a new Solomon system, ensuring data integrity and compliance
• Coordinated the year 2000 issues project, ensuring that our computer systems and manufacturing equipment were Y2K compliant
• Equipped and trained sales teams to leverage technology
• Provided end-user support and customized programming for the new ERP system, ensuring seamless adoption and minimal disruption
• Designed and implemented disaster recovery procedures and hardware/software standardization across the organization
• Managed workstation/network software, maintained and repaired computers and printers, and troubleshooted network issues
• Negotiated contracts with phone companies and installed Wide Area Networks, Local Area Networks, and a Raid 5 system
• Oversaw a team of 95 end-users across multiple locations, ensuring efficient support and minimizing downtime

As a seasoned IT professional, I've had the opportunity to develop and implement technical solutions that drive business efficiency and productivity. Some of my key accomplishments include:

• Ensured seamless operation of computer systems by installing software, maintaining and repairing computers and printers, and troubleshooting network problems
• Managed and maintained critical infrastructure, including network faxing, e-mail, and MDBS database systems
• Conducted evaluations and implemented new record tracking, network scheduling, and bulletin board systems to enhance business processes and productivity
• Implemented a robust backup and recovery strategy, ensuring the daily backup of all files and minimizing data loss in case of an emergency

As an early sales professional, I've had the opportunity to develop and implement successful business strategies that drive revenue growth and customer satisfaction. Some of my key accomplishments include:

• Successfully sold Real-Time Networking products, specifically SCRAMNet, to government and commercial businesses, establishing strong relationships and driving revenue growth
• Demonstrated exceptional account management skills, managing current accounts, creating new ones, processing purchase orders, and handling complex government contracts
• Proven ability to work with domestic and international accounts, navigating cultural and language barriers to deliver exceptional customer service
• Coordinated and executed successful trade show appearances in various states, showcasing products and building brand awareness
